sentences.text: At the joint request of the parties, the matter is adjourned to 18/02/2021.

2] Till the next date there shall be ad-interim relief in following terms :
3] In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with Crime No.490/2020 registered with Gangakhed Police Station, Dist.Parbhani for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 328, 272, 273 of the I.P.C. and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he shall be released on bail on his executing personal recognizance for an amount of Rs.15,000/- (Rs.Fifteen thousand only) and furnishing a solvent surety in the like amount subject to following conditions :
a] He shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when called by the Investigating Officer and shall cooperate him.
b] He shall not tamper the evidence or influence the witnesses.
